note: Des Moines River bottomland of restored wetland, sand prairie and young timber north of Wayland; not an island today, and there is no boat ramp. The map marks three camping areas, each beside a small gravel lot on its own county road: this pin is the lot at the river's edge off CR 193; the others are off CR 198 (west) and CR 389 (north). --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites; Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack'; brochure 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all graveled area parking lots', 14 days; map (5/29/2026) three Camping Area symbols, each beside a lot = GIS 569-571. All by county road. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights manual. PIN fine (GIS 571 on lot 3179). No split. Not waterfront kept (riverview lead only). Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Camping: Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack(no Deer/Turkey); Designated Camping Sites'. Brochure: 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all graveled area parking lots. No unattended open campfires allowed. Stays are limited to 14 consecutive days...'; 'Walk-in camping is allowed year round, EXCEPT during all firearms deer and turkey seasons. During these seasons camping is only allowed on or adjacent to graveled area parking lots.' Map (last updated 5/29/2026) legend 'Camping Area'; a camping symbol beside each of the three Parking symbols, = GIS 569, 570, 571. Designated points beside gravel lots, none a boat-ramp lot (the page: 'there is no boat ramp'): stays. No horse camp, ford or rig wording.

ISLAND ACCESS: road, not boat. The map shows all three camps on county roads (CR 193, CR 198, CR 389) from Highway 27 / Wayland; the 'island' is river bottomland on the Missouri side of the Des Moines River.

CAMPS: 571 (= pin, 40.43613,-91.53500) on lot 3179, a gravel lot ~40 x 15 m edged with boulders at the end of a gravel drive off CR 193, by the river. 569 (40.44767,-91.55562) beside lot 1154, a gravel turnaround ~20 m across on the service road off CR 198, in open field, 2.2 km NW. 570 (40.45662,-91.54756) beside lot 1156, a small gravel pull-off at the end of CR 389 on the river bank, 2.5 km N; the point itself is ~50 m into the woods from the lot.

CLUSTERS / NO SPLIT: the three camps are 2.2-2.5 km apart, each off its own county road, but each is a single small lot, so no split is proposed (the Fox Valley rule). If AWH wants them listed, candidates are the west lot 40.44794,-91.55584 and the north lot 40.45674,-91.54819; near.py: nothing else in campgrounds.json within 3 km.
PIN: stored 40.43613,-91.53500 = GIS 571, on the south edge of lot 3179; fine.

WATERFRONT LEAD (not waterfront kept): the Des Moines River (~150 m wide, river) is ~45-55 m east of the pin lot across a wooded bank band (leaf-off imagery); the north lot 1156 is ~40 m from the bank through trees. A filtered river view is possible at either in leaf-off but no MDC photo shows it, so it stays down.
Note rewritten: acreage, generic MDC text, the 14-day limit (now booking.max_stay_nights), 'site length not published' and directions dropped; the three camps and their roads put in.
